description: The value at FILE#/POINTER as one line of JSON ("[too big] ..." past max_bytes: look deeper or full: true); $ref/$env are not resolved. Also reads markdown (read only): FILE.md#/Heading is a section, #/Heading/_ its own text, #/Heading/0 a list item or table row, a list item key: value by its key, a section holding only a json block as JSON. More: aos/tools/json_get.md.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think; FILE alone = whole file

max_bytes.description: size limit for the printed value
